comment: Synthetic store N10-233 (1.2.10 row 40), cases S-6 and S-7 (AND rule). Rule-4 group A: exact duplicate device-only user notes p4m-a1 (newest, the keeper, exported) and p4m-a2 (not exported) -> the keeper loses vaultAllowed. Rule-4 group B: p4m-b1 and p4m-b2 both exported -> the keeper keeps it. Rule-1/3 group C: device-only agent notes with the same hook, p4m-c1 (exported, no body) and p4m-c2 (not exported, with a body that flows into the keeper) -> the keeper loses vaultAllowed.
